ugrian: A Mongolian race, ancestors of the Finns. [Written also Uigrian.]
ugly: 1. Offensive to the sight; contrary to beauty; being of disagreeable or loathsome aspect; unsightly; repulsive; deformed. The ugly view of his deformed crimes. Spenser. | A shade for the face, projecting from the bonnet. [Colloq. Eng.] C. Kingsley.
ugsome: Ugly; offensive; loathsome. (old) -- Ug"some*ness, n. (old) "The horror and ugsomeness of death." Latimer.
uglify: To disfigure; to make ugly. Mad. D'Arblay.
ugliness: The quality or state of being ugly.
ugh: An exclamation expressive of disgust, horror, or recoil. Its utterance is usually accompanied by a shudder.
uglily: In an ugly manner; with deformity.
